title: Server
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/712895ba04b602802ad9b1455179bc8d1690cebd.png)

Magner Weira has a server with 𝑛n components. Each component works only within a certain temperature range: component 𝑖i tolerates temperatures from 𝑙𝑖li to 𝑟𝑖ri, inclusive. If the temperature leaves this range, the component burns out permanently.

Magner has been so busy that he has neglected the server for 𝑚m days. Worried that some components may have burned out, he checks the room's temperature records. The only available record lists the minimum temperature 𝑎𝑗aj and maximum temperature 𝑏𝑗bj reached on each day 𝑗j.

For each component, determine the first day on which it burned out, or report that it is still working after these 𝑚m days.

## Input

The first line contains two integers 𝑛n and 𝑚m (1≤𝑛≤1051≤n≤105, 1≤𝑚≤1051≤m≤105), the numbers of components and days.

Each of the next 𝑛n lines contains two integers 𝑙𝑖li and 𝑟𝑖ri (1≤𝑙𝑖≤𝑟𝑖≤1051≤li≤ri≤105), the temperature limits of component 𝑖i.

Each of the following 𝑚m lines contains two integers 𝑎𝑗aj and 𝑏𝑗bj (1≤𝑎𝑗≤𝑏𝑗≤1051≤aj≤bj≤105), the minimum and maximum temperatures on day 𝑗j.

## Output

Print 𝑛n lines. Line 𝑖i must contain the first day on which component 𝑖i burned out, or −1−1 if it is still working after all 𝑚m days. Days are numbered from 11 to 𝑚m.

## Note

**Explanation for example 1**

The first component tolerates temperatures between 1010 and 2020: it survives the first two days but burns out on the third, when the minimum is 99. The third component burns out on the first day because the minimum, 1212, is below its lower limit of 1515. The second component tolerates all recorded temperatures.
